PROBLEM: The ice maker does not work
CHECK THE FOLLOWING: Is the freezer cold enough to make ice? It could take overnight for the freezer to reach the proper temperature. Is the ON/OFF lever in the ON (down) position? (See page 15.) Is the water valve turned on? Does the water line have a clog or leak?

PROBLEM: You hear unfa- miliar sounds or a rattling/ jingling noise
CHECK THE FOLLOWING: ls something on top of or behind the refrigerator? Some new sounds are normal. See “Understanding the sounds you may hear" on page 20.

PROBLEM: There is water in the defrost pan
CHECK THE FOLLOWING: This is normal on hot, muggy days. Make sure the refrigerator is level so the pan does not overflow.

PROBLEM: The motor seems to run too much
CHECK THE FOLLOWING: Are the condenser coils dirty? Has the door been open often? Has a large amount of food been added at one time? The motor naturally runs longer in these cases. Is the room hot? If the room is too warm, the motor runs longer to keep the unit cool.
